ticks.note: **sleepT = 300**. The local clock is renamed internally and not shown in the pool.

The clock reaches 300 in this tick, so the inner timeout fires (timeout = true): kick is a weak abort, so Run's inner behaviour runs first. Then the kick's effect sets timeout = false and re-enters Run, which restarts the clock: **timeout = false, sleepT = 300**, taken = [1, 1].
The restarted clock reaches 300, 300 time units after the kick: **timeout = true**, **sleepT = 1000**.
